description: Cards missing from a deck (not coverable from the collection) with the cheapest cached printing price per card (`cheapest_price`, non-foil, and `cheapest_printing` as "SET number"; both null when no printing has a price yet) and a price-to-complete total in `currency` (default USD). The total leaves unpriced cards out: say how many rows have no price. Prices come from the local printings cache (nightly refresh). Run claim_from_collection first, or copies the user owns and has not claimed are still counted as coverable, not missing.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

name: whats_missing

price_to_complete.description: Leaves out the rows with no price: say how many

rate_missing.description: Present when CHF was asked and no CHF rate is stored: no CHF price could be given at all, the cards are not unpriced. Relay it.

also_shared_with.description: This deck's own copies another deck also claims as shared: the two decks cannot be played at once. Always disclose.

cheapest_price.description: Non-foil; null: no printing has a price yet

claimable.description: Free copies in the collection: not missing. On a tournament deck, real copies only

held_elsewhere.description: On a row with copies missing: copies the user owns that another deck claims. Never call the card "not owned".

is_proxy.description: A proxy is not a real card: say so

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

lang.description: The row's own language, Scryfall's code (de, ja, zhs…); null follows the deck's

lang_asked.description: The language the row asks for: its own, else the deck's; null any. A preference: a copy in another language still counts

missing.description: On a tournament deck this counts copies only a proxy covers: see proxies_missing

pinned_scryfall_id.description: The printing the row pins; null: any printing

proxies_allocated.description: Claimed copies that are proxies: always say so

proxies_missing.description: Of missing, on a tournament deck: copies the deck plays as a proxy. Say so: "you play a proxy; a tournament needs the real card". 0 on a casual deck

scryfall_url.description: The cheapest priced printing, else the card by name: link the name to it

shared_detail.description: Borrowed copies: which other decks also claim them and where they physically are. Always disclose.

shared_in.description: Copies borrowed as shared from other decks: always disclose, with shared_detail

sleeved.description: Of allocated: copies physically in the deck; the rest are staged, still where they were

title: Whats missing
